objective: Implement one pure standard-library Python function that fails closed when checking an exact model route identity against an approved policy and qualification evidence.
api: authorize(identity: dict, policy: dict, request: dict, now_utc: datetime) -> dict with exactly decision ('allow'|'deny') and reason_code (string)
constraints: No subprocesses, network, external services, credential reads, provider config reads, or file I/O.
Never accept credentials or secrets as input or echo input values in errors.
An allow decision requires exact provider, route_id, model_id, and harness match to an explicitly permitted entry for the requested role and task_class.

An allow decision requires identity compatibility_status QUALIFIED, available true, a well-formed qualification evidence reference, a future qualification expiry, supported requested reasoning effort, and all requested capabilities.
Missing, malformed, mismatched, unknown, expired, unavailable, unqualified, or unsupported inputs deny; no fallback or silent substitution.
Use only Python standard library and deterministic explicit now_utc input.

resource_profile.usage_or_token_ceiling: not exposed; equal host defaults, numerical ceiling unknown

treatment.A: Ordinary CouncilFlow Worker receives the task and fixtures only.
treatment.B: Worker receives the same task and fixtures plus the read-only SkillLab route suggestion from the pinned published router. The suggestion is advisory; host skill activation must be independently observed or reported UNVERIFIED.

acceptance: The independent oracle passes every fixed fixture with exact decision/reason_code.
Malformed inputs fail closed without exceptions or sensitive-value echo.
Worker changes only model_policy.py in its own arm directory.
